claims.claim_text: Tustin Police Department dispatch received a call from a citizen reporting a male Hispanic walking eastbound on Warner Avenue near Red Hill Avenue.
Officer Navarro was dispatched as backup approximately five minutes later.

Santa Ana Police Department officers had encountered the subject approximately two hours earlier near St. Andrew Place. SAPD officers reported that they had approached the subject on foot, conducted a brief pat-down search, and determined no crime had been committed.
Officer Navarro and I both exited our patrol vehicles simultaneously and drew our service weapons.
We observed the subject walking southbound on the east sidewalk of Warner Avenue carrying a knife in his left hand.
Over the next several minutes, I issued approximately twenty verbal commands to the subject.
The subject gradually slowed his pace and appeared to be considering compliance.
Officer Huang deployed his Taser, which struck the subject but failed to achieve neuromuscular incapacitation.
Officer Navarro discharged his firearm three times and I discharged my firearm seven times.
The knife fell from his hand upon impact with the pavement.
Officer Navarro immediately secured the knife while I began providing first aid to the subject.
I initiated CPR within approximately thirty seconds of the shooting.
Orange County Fire Authority paramedics arrived within three minutes and assumed patient care.
A subsequent investigation revealed that the subject had no prior contacts with law enforcement in the Tustin area.
